summary: Prefill the host Networking management form from the live Nex-managed configuration. Core parses /etc into inventory.management_network.current (stage none when no change record); the UI seeds from current. API impact: changed contract (ManagementNetworkStatus.current; stage enum gains none).

guide.reason: Change-management-network steps now say the Interfaces table and DNS start filled from the host's reported current configuration when Nex manages the files.

api.reason: ManagementNetworkStatus gains current (live parsed Spec) and stage may be none when there is no change record but Current is reported. Spec remains the staged/applied/last change. Both sides: Core projects Current; Controller GET already passes the status through; UI seeds the edit form from current. Older Cores omit current; the UI falls back to spec then blanks.

roadmap.reason: Bug fix for an existing management-network panel; no phase gate movement.

state.reason: The live configuration is the host's own Nex-managed /etc files; Current is an observation projected into inventory so a fresh Controller adopts it with nothing to re-enter.
state.record: Host-scoped. Same durable files as the management-network edit path (/etc/network/interfaces, /etc/dhcpcd.conf, /etc/resolv.conf) plus optional <state-dir>/management-network.json for in-flight changes. Inventory.management_network.current is parsed from those files on every report; a replacement Controller reads it back with the host's inventory.

verification.method: go test ./internal/vmhost/ -run 'TestManagementNetworkRender|TestReadManagementNetworkStatusReportsCurrent'; node web/src/host-network.test.mjs; python3 -m unittest tests.test_api_contract.HostNetworkContractTests; python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_repository_privacy.py'. Native host and browser walkthrough not re-run in this change.
